name: Everything's Bigger in Texas 2016

venue.name: [North Office Building](https://facilitiesservices.utexas.edu/buildings/UTM/0983)
venue.details: Follow the signs from the garage towards the venue.

information: There is a 25-competitor limit and a $15 registration fee for this competition. This is to cover the costs of the competition. Registration will open at noon on Sunday, October 9th. Please note that your registration will not be complete until you have paid the registration fee.
